assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Cardiac event monitoring was performed with CPT 93271
The service was medically necessary to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to these embolic events
The clinical indication note documents the service
The payer's denial under Reason Code PR-204 states that this service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The service is directly tied to the patient's documented embolic events and underlying cardiac conditions
